column1: # Every unguarded `NAME=$( ... grep ... )` assignment the guard finds in its
# population (health/status surfaces). Under errexit + pipefail, grep's no-match
# exit 1 fails such an assignment and aborts the enclosing shell.
# ⛔ THIS IS A DEBT REGISTER, NOT AN ALLOWLIST. A row means the site is KNOWN and
# not yet triaged, not that it is safe. Whether errexit is live at a site depends
# on its caller: `main "$@" || exit $?` in cli/sbin/nftban suspends errexit in the
# main call tree, but a `< <(...)` process substitution runs with it (that is how
# the BotScan facts line died in v1.234.0). Rows were seeded at gate birth from
#   disposition  DEBT          unguarded; abort not ruled out
#                CONTEXT_SAFE  proven to run with errexit off (say where, in the handle)
#   site         the logical line, backslash continuations joined, whitespace collapsed
# Fixing a site makes its row STALE and the guard fails until the row is removed:
# a fix and its reconciliation land together.

column4: score_output=$(systemd-analyze security "$service" 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^→ Overall exposure level:' | head -1)
